from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import json
p=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/supervisor-events.jsonl')
counts=Counter();kind_sources=Counter();success=Counter();dates=[]
for line in p.open(encoding='utf-8'):
 try:row=json.loads(line)
 except (ValueError,UnicodeError):continue
 if not isinstance(row,dict):continue
 event=row.get('event')
 if not isinstance(event,dict):continue
 typ=str(event.get('kind',event.get('status',event.get('event_type','MISSING'))))
 counts[typ]+=1
 for k in ('member_added','members_added','invite_ok','adds_ok','approved_user_ids_done'):
  val=event.get(k)
  if val and isinstance(val,int):success[k]+=val
  elif isinstance(val,str) and val.casefold() in ('true','success','yes'):success[k]+=1
 for k in ('account','session'):
  if k in event:kind_sources[k]+=1
 if isinstance(row.get('ts'),(str,int,float)):dates.append(row['ts'])
print('NESTED_EVENT_KINDS',counts.most_common(45))
print('SUCCESS_RELATED_SUM',dict(success))
print('ACCOUNT_ATTRIBUTION_FIELDS_COUNT',dict(kind_sources))
print('TS_FIRST_LAST',str(dates[0])[:40] if dates else None,str(dates[-1])[:40] if dates else None)
print('EXACT_EVENT_FIELDS',sorted(event.keys()) if isinstance(event,dict) else [])
for directory in ('/root/TELEGRAM-IPTVPN','/opt/TELEGRAM-IPTVPN','/root/telegram-robot-leads','/opt/telegram-iptvpn','/home/ubuntu/TELEGRAM-IPTVPN'):
 d=Path(directory)
 if not d.is_dir() or d.is_symlink():continue
 print('LEGACY_DIRECTORY_EXISTS',directory)
 for name in ('users.db','estado_bot.json','telethon_adder.log'):
  file=d/name
  if file.is_file() and not file.is_symlink():print('LEGACY_HISTORICAL_FILE',name,'BYTES',file.stat().st_size)
print('HISTORICAL_EVENT_AUDIT_COMPLETE')
